name: lane-whoosh-soft
prompt: A soft, quick airy whoosh of a small vehicle swishing sideways into an adjacent lane, short and clean.

name: lane-whoosh-quick
prompt: A fast, sharp whoosh of air as a racing pod darts sideways across the track, bright attack with a short tail.

name: lane-whoosh-deep
prompt: A low, deep whoosh of a heavy craft sliding one lane over, muffled rumble with a quick fade.

name: boost-ignition
prompt: A punchy rocket-style ignition burst from a boost engine, crackling flare-up followed by a rising roar.

name: boost-surge
prompt: A powerful turbine surge as a speed boost kicks in, accelerating jet-like roar building from low to high pitch.

name: boost-roar
prompt: A sustained aggressive engine roar of a racing vehicle at full boost, loud throttle growl with wind rushing past.

name: crash-impact
prompt: A heavy metallic crash impact of a vehicle slamming into an obstacle, loud clang with crunching debris.

name: crash-scrape
prompt: A harsh grinding scrape of metal bodywork dragging along a barrier during a collision, screeching and rough.

name: crash-thud
prompt: A dull heavy thud of a vehicle body hitting the ground after a crash, short and weighty.

name: finish-fanfare
prompt: A short triumphant brass fanfare with a bright horn flourish as the racer crosses the finish line.

name: finish-chime
prompt: A bright sequence of rising bell chimes celebrating a race finish, clear and sparkling.

name: finish-applause
prompt: A small crowd applauding and cheering at a finish line, warm claps and excited shouts.
